messages:
Elliot (SE): NexaMed POC streaming stalls when going through corp proxy. Python client starts then hangs after ~15s, no exception. Anyone seen this with TLS re-signing middleboxes?
Maya (AE): They confirm it works if they bypass the proxy. On proxy it's reproducible. They asked about Private deployment to avoid inspection.
Jon (Solutions): Do we have client logs or gateway traces? trace id?
Elliot (SE): Gateway shows intermittent 502/503 and some upstream 401 before success. Client shows connection open but no payload. Using @redwood/py 1.2.0, Python 3.11.
Rana (Eng): Common pattern: inspector buffers small chunks until threshold or closes idle upstreams after auth. Quick fixes: increase client chunk flush, add periodic heartbeat bytes, bump header size. Python SDK has a heartbeat helper in 1.2.3.
Elliot (SE): Patching to call client._send_heartbeat() every 8s and bumped chunk_size. Running tests now.
Maya (AE): I'll prepare Private/VPC pricing (they asked for 2 A100 monthly commit) and attach security answers (SAML, SCIM, customer KMS).
infra-bot: Ticket RT-4010 created by Rana: "python sdk: add streaming heartbeat option + docs" assigned to eng-runtime. ETA 6d.
Elliot (SE): Update: with heartbeat + upgraded SDK streaming stayed healthy for 35m in a soak. Logged a 30s gap once then resumed. Sending logs to Rana.
Rana (Eng): That matches inspector buffering + TLS re-handshake. I'll add a sample heartbeat snippet to docs and an SDK flag to enable it by default in a follow-up.
Jon (Solutions): Next steps: (1) Maya send Private quote, (2) Nexa infra to share appliance buffer settings, (3) Rana ship SDK docs + small PR, (4) Elliot run overnight soak and report.
Elliot (SE): Will run soak and re-open if it recurs. Thanks everyone!
